Yes, the issue had enough detail to reproduce it, and the fix is up as PR [#410](https://github.com/cv/pit/pull/410). All local checks pass, including tests and coverage. CI fails on Node 22, but in the dependency audit step, not in this change; Node 24 and 26 were still running when I last checked.

**Reproduction:** step 4 of the issue is the exact trigger. It's a finished assistant reply with no tool call whose last line starts with `[Pit: elided tool call`. Before the fix, Pit did nothing at the end of such a turn, so the run stopped with nothing executed and no notice. The new test `test/globals/imitated-calls.test.ts` builds that reply in a real Pi session. I disabled the fix as a check, and the two tests that expect a notice failed, as they should.

**What the PR does:**
- **Detect it and say so (proposal 1):** a new check in `src/context/imitated-calls.ts` catches such a reply at the end of its turn. Pit then:
  - adds a notice telling the model that no tool ran and the action didn't happen;
  - asks for one more response so the model can make the call;
  - shows the user a one-line warning starting `▲ No tool ran`.
- **Loop guard:** if the reply right after a notice makes the same mistake, it gets the notice again but no extra response. A later slip, after a normal reply, counts as new.
- **Not flagged:** replies that also make a tool call, a placeholder quoted inside prose or a code block, and aborted replies.
- **Say it in the placeholder (proposal 3):** placeholders now end with `· already ran; writing this text runs nothing`, on both Pi and pi-durable hosts. The prefix is unchanged, so placeholders already in existing sessions are still recognised.
- The CHANGELOG and `docs/reference.md` are updated.

**Left out:**
- **Proposal 2** (a format the model never writes itself) would undo #292's decision not to leave a stub call the model could copy. Better to wait and see whether 1 and 3 are enough.
- **Proposal 4** (counting cases in session analysis) needs a new field in `

ops:
sessions.readEvents`. It's a good follow-up for measuring before and after.
- **pi-durable** hosts get the new placeholder wording but not the end-of-turn check.
